S033-D6: From the formulas on scan 22, in characteristic 3 one has c_4=a_2² and d_6=2a_2a_4. Thus invertibility of c_4 makes a_2 a unit and d_6=0 is equivalent to a_4=0. This checks the bottom paragraph’s d_6 reading. S033-KERNEL: For the formal polynomial maps given by the proposition, reduction modulo the monic relation Y²−X³ leaves monomials X^iY^j with j=0 or 1. Under X↦a_1⁴,Y↦a_1⁶ their exponents are 4i and 4i+6, distinct modulo 4; under X↦b_2²,Y↦−b_2³ they are 2i and 2i+3, of different parity. With Δ an independent variable, no further relation appears in these polynomial targets. This checks the algebraic implication of the stated ring descriptions, not the full modular-form theorem or the marginal smoothness assertions.
